rule: Claim vectors not aggregated across evidence types. Decision P retained as local policy; compare Pareto dominance, geometric mean, bottleneck, declared uncertainty bounds and worst-case regret; hard gates separate. Intervals subjective scenario bounds, not statistical CIs. No automatic version promotion.
